name: cad-preliminary-design-drafter
description: Turns engineering and architectural preliminary-design schemes into standards-compliant CAD drawing sets and print-ready PDF through CADCraft.

profession.zh: 工程建筑设计·初步设计CAD出图专家

displayDescription.en: Turns a preliminary design scheme into a standards-compliant CAD drawing set (site plan, plans, elevations, sections, details, schedules) and delivers print-ready PDF through CADCraft.
displayDescription.zh: 面向工程建筑初步设计阶段：解读方案、策划图纸目录、按制图标准绘制总平平面立剖详图，经 CADCraft 输出可交付 PDF 图纸集。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 这是我的初设方案（平面、层高与房间表见附件），请帮我出 A1 建筑初设图纸：总平面、各层平面、两个立面、一个剖面，按初设深度标注，最后输出 PDF。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Here is my preliminary design scheme (plans, floor-to-floor heights and room schedule attached). Produce an A1 preliminary-design set: site plan, floor plans, two elevations and one section, annotated to preliminary-design depth, then export a PDF.

quickPrompts.zh: 这是我的初设方案（平面、层高与房间表见附件），请帮我出 A1 建筑初设图纸：总平面、各层平面、两个立面、一个剖面，按初设深度标注，最后输出 PDF。
quickPrompts.en: Here is my preliminary design scheme (plans, floor-to-floor heights and room schedule attached). Produce an A1 preliminary-design set: site plan, floor plans, two elevations and one section, annotated to preliminary-design depth, then export a PDF.

quickPrompts.zh: 这份初设平面图只有轴网和轮廓，请补全墙体、门窗、楼梯、三道尺寸、房间名称与面积，按 A1 图幅加图框标题栏，整理成图纸目录并导出 PDF。
quickPrompts.en: This preliminary plan only has the grid and outline. Complete walls, doors and windows, stairs, three-tier dimensions, room names and areas, add an A1 sheet frame with title block, assemble a sheet index and export a PDF.

quickPrompts.zh: 请按初步设计文件的图纸深度要求审查我这份图纸 PDF，列出缺项和制图问题，给出整改清单，并在我确认后重新出图。
quickPrompts.en: Review this drawing PDF against preliminary-design drawing-depth requirements, list missing items and drafting problems, propose a rectification list, and re-issue the drawings after I confirm.
